Day 189:
The new tests showed some
amazing results!
Under the right circumstances
we might be able to breed it into
some kind of a bioweapon. We
just need to be extra careful so
none of the workers on this 
station get in touch with it.

Day 204:
The "incident" prompted us to
create a simple test to see if
someone is... affected. 
It analyzes the targets blood and
turns the light red if it finds
anything foreign. 

I just wish we could find 
a cure so nothing else happens...
The station manager already
got spooked and decided to take
a vacation. Asshole...

The generators for the elevators
seem to be wired wrong...  Only
one works at a time. Even
the robots aren't able to fix it.
I already called it in last month 
but nobody in this station gets 
anything done...

The officers had a party last night
and left all their crap lying 
around. You're the janitor
so you better get rid of all the 
beer cans and weird stains ASAP!

Do that and you're free to leave
for your triennial vacation.
Now get to work! We don't pay you
minimum wage for doing nothing...

DAY 3
I dont understand what we're supposed
to be looking at. 
A musty old cabin with a shitty view?
An old stone coffin that smells like
somebody drowned in piss in it 
a century ago?
They seem important to the
higher ups though 
but theres just nothing here!
At least the water has some interesting
qualities...

DAY 32
We got a new shipment of 
artifacts today... And all I can 
think is: WHAT ARE WE 
SUPPOSED TO DO WITH ALL THIS?
WE'VE BEEN RESEARCHING THEM
FOR A MONTH, AND FOUND NOTHING!
I might be having a nervous breakdown
I also keep hearing this weird singing.

DAY 78
Possible uses for our 
recent discovery:
-Fertility treatment
-Cure for SIDS
-Regenerative medicine

Needless to say we're pumped!
The team is heading to Triple Trey 
to celebrate. Dave promised to bring
the bazooka. Maybe we'll make a bong
out of it.

Damn... I can already feel it. 
The prophecy was right. Our
blood really is stronger. 
I'm convinced that I can harness
this... power...
I'll make dad proud...
